title: UI风格#16 - Bauhaus Digital (包豪斯数字)
description: 创建第16种UI风格：包豪斯数字风格 - 几何构成，红黄蓝三原色、功能主义。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planP.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Digital style When color palette Then features primary red, yellow, blue with black and white
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #E63946 red, #F4D03F yellow, #2A9D8F blue, #1A1A1A black, #FAFAF8 white palette

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Digital style When typography Then uses geometric fonts: Bauhaus 93, Futura, or Montserrat
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Bebas Neue (headers), IBM Plex Mono (body), Playfair Display (accents)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Digital style When layout Then geometric shapes, grid composition, primary color blocks
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: 8px grid system, geometric shapes as semantic elements, hard offset shadows

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Digital style When UI elements Then geometric shapes as buttons, primary color accents, grid borders
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: geometric buttons, 4px borders, offset shadows 4px 4px 0 #000

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Digital UI When functional Then includes geometric chat, color-block agents, grid stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: terminal chat, RED/BLUE/YELLOW/BLACK agents, geometric stats, action buttons

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Digital UI When copy Then uses functional language: 'Form', 'Function', 'Structure', 'Grid'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'FORM. FUNCTION. GRID.', buttons EXECUTE/BUILD/HALT/RECORD, status FORMING/IN MOTION
